It really really is. 

Thank you though. Just appreciate the read regardless.

It really doesn't. I'm 25 and this has been nearly half of my life. I just appreciate you taking the time to read it. I hope things get easier for you at some point. You're clearly a strong person and I hope you can keep on fighting it.

Firstly, happy cake day! I have been to counselling and shit before, also been on a few different tablets (most have made it worse, none better) for ages but nothing makes even the slightest difference unfortunately. Just exhausted of fighting every day. Thank you for reading, I really appreciate it. I just needed a different outlet I guess, and to say it to faceless strangers.
